scenarios.name: normal_mixing
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 18 °C with OAT 5 / RAT 22 sits 4 °C below the high bound; nothing to report

scenarios.name: mat_above_envelope
scenarios.description: Reference vector: MAT 28 °C is 6 °C above max(oat, rat) = 22 °C; alarms at alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: within_tolerance
scenarios.description: Mirror of the FC#2 within-tolerance vector: MAT 23 °C is 1 °C above the high bound — inside eps_MAT

scenarios.name: edge_gap_equals_tolerance
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: mat − max(oat, rat) = 2.0 °C exactly; the comparison is strict, so this is healthy

scenarios.name: edge_gap_just_over_tolerance
scenarios.description: Threshold edge, other side: a gap of 2.1 °C clears the strict comparison and alarms at alarm_delay

scenarios.name: summer_oat_above_rat
scenarios.description: Cooling season with OAT above RAT: OAT 30 °C is now the high bound and MAT 34 °C sits 4 °C over it

scenarios.name: low_excursion_is_not_this_fault
scenarios.description: MAT 1 °C is 4 °C below the envelope — a real violation, but the low side belongs to AHU-FC-002

scenarios.name: transient_excursion_never_alarms
scenarios.description: MAT rises above the bound for 1200 s (< alarm_delay) during a damper stroke and recovers; the timer resets unfired

scenarios.name: fault_clears_on_recovery
scenarios.description: Sustained high excursion alarms at 1800 s; recalibration at 3600 s drops the alarm on the same tick
